[[File:Heath Scheiman portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Heath Scheiman.]]
'''Heath Scheiman''' (also published as '''Heath Scherman''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 75 from Cincinnati, Oh. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He played the [[1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)]], where [[Joe Alread]] defeated him by 5 in a rematch of their 1996 Worlds pairing.<ref name="list-53912" /> As Heath Scherman he wrote [[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace CCGs]] in ''[[InQuest]]'' #49 (May 1999, page 24).<ref name="wp-swccg">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016121021/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
